summary: Work is complete and I am adding nothing new: with roughly four minutes of run allocation left and no pending receipt, another artifact could not be verified. Final state of the run - three sourced investigations, each with two independent clean-copy runs and a grounded account. (1) Explicit leadership transfer accepts a caller-named non-voter: the future reports success while the named target never leads and the incumbent is forced to re-elect, with the successor's identity varying by schedule. (2) One allowed StoreLogs error in the conflict-truncation window wedges the follower permanently - store truncated (last index 4 to 2), certificate pinned at (4,2), no further store attempt, commit stuck at 2 - costing exactly one unit of commitment-quorum margin (the five-voter control tolerates two voter losses, the wedged cluster only one), repaired only by a restart or by a leader snapshot install, the latter reachable under defaults only after roughly the trailing window of entries. (3) The growth sequence the library documents (bootstrap one voter, then AddVoter the next server) commits the change and returns a successful future while permanently removing the only node's leadership and write availability; neither RemoveServer nor AddNonvoter for the absent server is accepted in that state, whereas the staged AddNonvoter form keeps the cluster serving. Boundaries, counterevidence, limitations and the negative/scoping results are all recorded with their receipts.
